system.description:
• Trained within the independent Mournas druidic tradition — Farood (Gold Rank) and Harmen (Druid of the Mournas Woods) are the two known figures of this circle, which operates separately from the Cabal.
  • Urban Dismissal: Advantage on Dismiss Woodland Creatures checks used against creatures in or beneath a city. Once per encounter in a town or city, as part of casting a spell, set the rats and pigeons on one creature within 30ft: it has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.
  • City's Wild: Advantage finding shelter, safe passage, or allies in Mournas using urban nature — the rats in the walls, the moss on the stones, the gardens between buildings.
